nodes.name: Read sent log
nodes.notes: Read once per run, not once per comment. alwaysOutputData so an empty log still lets the first DM through.

nodes.name: Not messaged today
nodes.notes: Rate limit per person. Meta restricts accounts that DM the same user repeatedly.

nodes.name: Send private reply (DM)
nodes.notes: Private Replies only work once per comment and only within 7 days of it. This node only sends query parameters (it has no body field), which the Graph API accepts for POST.

nodes.name: Log to sheet
nodes.notes: RAW, so Sheets stores Instagram ids as text. Parsed as numbers, 17-digit ids lose precision and stop matching.

nodes.name: Public reply under comment
nodes.notes: Social proof. Only posted once the DM has actually gone out, so it never says "check your DMs" over an empty inbox.
